decisions.reason: The low-noise burner improves the firm's core infrared heater line, and with industry turnover growing it is a cheap, low-risk upgrade that likely meets aspirations.
Presented on its own page in 2019, the plaque heater is central to the firm's narrow core range, and nothing signals results below aspiration that would trigger problemistic search.
The luminous radiant heater extends the established gas infrared business, so it uses existing competencies and needs little slack to carry despite the 2022 gas-price pressure.
Tube heaters are a staple for heating halls and fit the firm's core offer, so it is likely kept even though the energy crisis creates some uncertainty for gas-fired equipment.
The standard plaque heater, featured on its own page, is likely a volume product that performs at aspiration within the firm's core segment.
This second tube heater variant could be consolidated if gas demand weakens, but as part of the core line in a growing industry it is more likely kept.
